name: qkd_ahub_b-eafd37271-tc-hm10-cl
purpose: kv-die 2026-10-09 (OWNER DECISION option 1a): near-HBM attention hub on the KV die (max exchange, Z 5-10, P.V 8-9, reciprocal, x 1/Z). Variant b: same frame; hub: OT_MULTI_VT=lvt (<=~2% cells) / engine: GPL_TIMING_DRIVEN=0 (runtime). Re-try of the element DROPPED 10-04 under the old SS sign-off and a 6 h / 24-core cap (hub_r9 post-CTS SS -88.95 ps; row engines stopped in resize): option-B sign-off is TT setup / FF hold and the run has no wall-time cap. RTL unchanged (exact: results/uarch/qwen_nearhbm_attn_rtl_20261003/gate_hd128_r8_dpi.json 20/20, and the layer step through the link results/arch/qwen_kv_die_20261009/bench.json).
